## Inventory

_Verified against working tree at `7d0d885` (hf-facade-04 landed; registry reconciliation 003ed5e). `dataset/meta.py` and its `MetaCodec` / `Targets` no longer exist anywhere in `src/` (removed by `76778e5`, meta-dissolution) — targets are read from `frame.meta` directly. The map-style protocol is named `Dataset`._

### Module list

Root / L2 resolution — `src/molhub/`:

- `src/molhub/__init__.py` — front door; re-exports the three dataset functions plus `Molhub` / coordinate / manifest / registry types. Defines nothing.
- `src/molhub/_version.py` — `__version__` only.
- `src/molhub/coordinate.py` — `kind:namespace/name@version` parsing, shorthand expansion, `relative_path()` / `cache_path()` projections.
- `src/molhub/manifest.py` — strict single-manifest parser; `SCHEMA_VERSION = 1` enforced.
- `src/molhub/registry.py` — directory-backed manifest store; source order explicit path → `$MOLHUB_REGISTRY` → bundled `registry_data/`.
- `src/molhub/molhub.py` — composes `Registry` + `Fetcher`; coordinate → role→path. No HTTP of its own.
- `src/molhub/cli.py` — typer app: `search` / `info` / `fetch` + `cache verify|status|coverage`. `info` is content-first (renders `DatasetInfo` via `_describe`, falling back to the manifest).

Transport L1 — `src/molhub/sources/`:

- `locator.py` — frozen `scheme://path`, opaque to molhub.
- `digest.py` — `Digest` (md5/sha1/sha256/sha512, constant-time compare, streaming `of_file`) + `Sha256Stream`.
- `errors.py` — one typed failure per branch `Fetcher` takes.
- `remote.py` — `RemoteFile`, one downloadable file as a driver reports it.
- `publication.py` — `Publication`, platform-neutral upload metadata.
- `source.py` — three-level protocol ladder `FileTransfer` → `Source` → `PublishingSource`.
- `blobs.py` — `BlobStore`, `$MOLHUB_HOME` cache layout (`files/<key>/…`, `tmp/`).
- `fetcher.py` — ordered locator fallback, cache short-circuit, optional digest check, atomic put.
- `drivers/__init__.py` — immutable scheme→driver map with entry-point discovery.
- `drivers/https.py` — the only transport implementation (status → `.part` → `replace`).
- `drivers/_api.py` — shared JSON-over-HTTP helper, 8 MiB body cap.
- `drivers/{zenodo,figshare,huggingface,molhub}.py` — locator→URL resolution per platform; figshare/huggingface also publish.

Semantic L3 — `src/molhub/dataset/`:

- `__init__.py` — subpackage facade; protocols, catalog, transforms, and every built-in dataset class.
- `protocol.py` — `Sample = Frame | Trajectory` alias, `Dataset` / `IterableDataset` runtime-checkable protocols, `TargetSchema`, plus two concrete implementations (`InMemoryDataset`, `SubsetDataset`).
- `definition.py` — `@dataset(...)` class decorator attaching a `DatasetManifest`, and the immutable `Datasets` catalog (no process-global table).
- `hub.py` — `ArtifactHub`, the one-verb seam the layer requires from below.
- `cache.py` — `DownloadCache`, URL-addressed caching for inputs with no coordinate; root from `BlobStore`.
- `transforms.py` — `AtomicDress` (fit/execute), `UnitConvert`, `ConstantLabel`.
- `neighbor.py` — `NeighborListSeam` protocol + `NeighborDelegate` (molnex-side neighbor list injected, never imported).
- `csv_dataset.py` — `CSVDataset`, stdlib csv → `Frame`.
- `qm9.py`, `revmd17.py`, `threebpa.py` — coordinate-pinned classic sets; lazy (`qm9`) vs eager parse in `__init__` (the other two).
- `water_les.py` — `WaterLESDataset`, extxyz with lattice → `InMemoryDataset` via `.load()`.
- `zinc_typing.py`, `phalkethoh_mm.py` — espaloma split-bearing sets; expose `molecule_ids` / `split_table`.
- `molrec.py` — `MolRecDataset`, molpy `MolRec` → frames with force columns.
- `themol.py` — `THEMolShardDataset` (lazy per-process HDF5 handle, picklable) + five decorated definition classes; `THEMOL_UNITS` is the single unit table.
- `universal_class_i.py` — `CollectionRole` / `MultiSourceDatasetCollection` / `Class1Universal2026`, the multi-source role map.

Block plumbing — `src/molhub/conveyor/`:

- `__init__.py` — package facade; also owns the two shared caller decisions `DEFAULT_BUDGET_BYTES` and `default_ledger_path()`.
- `block.py` — `BlockId` + closed `BlockState` with a legality table.
- `ledger.py` — append-only JSONL `Ledger`: digest-per-line, torn-line discard, TTL leases as records.
- `roster.py` — `BlockRoster`, projects the registry manifest into `RemoteBlock`s (no second index).
- `splits.py` — `SplitProvenance` (sha256-verified `metadata.json`) and package-internal `_SplitTable`.
- `transfer.py` — `ShardTransfer`: lease → fetch → re-verify → delete on mismatch, with `ExponentialBackoff`.
- `encoder.py` — `THEMolUnitEncoder`, one record → one whole `RawUnit` of numpy columns.
- `prepare.py` — `PrepareJob` routing units to split-pure blocks; `MolnexBlockWriter` imports `molix` lazily.
- `errors.py` — the prepare-stage typed failures.
- `tier.py` — `TierStore` byte-bounded residency, `VisitOrder` eviction plan, `DerivedLayout`.
- `backpressure.py` — `ByteBoundedQueue` + `PrepareWorkers` process pool.
- `coverage.py` — `CoverageReport` replay and `ReadyBlocks` metadata (digests copied, never computed).

Loader façade L4 — `src/molhub/loader/`:

- `__init__.py` — defines `load_dataset` / `load_dataset_builder`, re-exports `prepare` and the loader types.
- `naming.py` — `DatasetName` (HF spelling → `Coordinate`), newest-version resolution, `AmbiguousRevision` when versions do not order.
- `info.py` — `Feature` / `SplitInfo` / `DatasetInfo`, content-first description built from `DatasetManifest` + `TargetSchema`.
- `builder.py` — `DatasetBuilder` plus the `SplitDeclaration` hierarchy (`TableBackedSplits` for THEMol shards; `DeclaredSplits` subclasses for water-les / zinc-typing / phalkethoh / 3BPA).
- `mapstyle.py` — `ShardIndex` (memoized key derivation with provenance) + `SplitDataset` map-style view; `ShardRecords` / `ShardSource` protocols.
- `streaming.py` — `StreamingSplitDataset` walking published parts under a disk budget, `BoundedStream` (`take`), `PublishedParts`.
- `materialize.py` — `SplitRouting`, `BlockExport`, and the sanctioned `prepare` function.

Write-side shims — `src/molhub/uploader/`:

- `__init__.py`, `figshare.py`, `huggingface.py` — `FigshareUploader` / `HuggingFaceUploader` forwarding to the drivers; deprecated.

Tests / regressions:

- `tests/` mirrors `src/` per package: `tests/test_loader/` (8 module tests + `test_layering.py` + `test_init.py`), `tests/test_conveyor/` (11 + `test_layering.py`), `tests/test_dataset/` (17, no `test_meta.py`), `tests/test_sources/` (+ `test_drivers/`), plus root-level core tests, `tests/conformance/`, `tests/test_docs_examples.py`.
- `regressions/` — 15+ scripts including the four `hf-facade-0*` chain scenarios.

### Style summary

- `loader/*` — types `PascalCase`, one noun per module; `DatasetBuilder(name, revision=, registry=, hub=)` with `registry`/`hub` injected as seams; views produced by methods (`split_view`, `streaming_view`, `block_export`), never factories; free functions: exactly three, machine-checked in `tests/test_loader/test_layering.py` (`_SANCTIONED_BY_MODULE`: `__init__.py` → the two readers, `materialize.py` → `prepare`); typed local errors (`AmbiguousRevision`, `UnknownRecordKey`, `KeyError` for unknown split, `ValueError` for streaming a whole-file dataset); Google docstrings whose module headers state the decision and cite `.claude/specs/hf-facade-0*` + the 2026-08-15 operator note.
- `loader/builder.py` — the one polymorphic module: `SplitDeclaration` ABC with a per-dataset subclass, so `DatasetBuilder` holds no `if dataset == …` ladder.
- `conveyor/*` — `*Store` / `*Job` / `*Transfer` / `*Report` by role; collaborators injected as protocols (`BlockLedger`, `TransferLedger`, `Clock`, `BlockWriterFactory`, `JobRunner`) — every unit fake-able; one `ConveyorError` root with a per-stage subtree; the two shared caller decisions (`DEFAULT_BUDGET_BYTES`, `default_ledger_path`) stated once in the `__init__` docstring; no env var, no network, no disk-layout decision of its own.
- `dataset/*` — uniform `*Dataset`, `COORDINATE` module constant, `TARGET_SCHEMA` / `SPLITS` class attrs; `hub: ArtifactHub | None` seam; `themol` / `water_les` / `molrec` / `universal_class_i` defer IO to `.load()`, `qm9` lazy, the rest parse in `__init__`; records are `molpy.Frame` / `Trajectory` only — no wrapper dataclasses, no meta codec, scalars from `frame.meta`; `source_id` convention: canonical coordinate verbatim, `#key=value` qualifiers for views, ad-hoc prefixes only where no coordinate exists (`csv:` / `memory:`; `SubsetDataset` appends `":subset=<hash12>"`).
- `definition.py` — `@dataset(...)` is a keyword-only class decorator doing no IO; `Datasets` immutable catalog with `with_dataset` — no import-time global registry.
- `sources/*` — one typed error per distinguishable failure; frozen dataclass value types; exactly one transport implementation (`drivers/https.py`); alternate constructors named for semantics (`Digest.parse` / `of_file`, `Drivers.builtin` / `discover`).
- `{coordinate,manifest,registry,molhub}.py` — pure value/parse layer: frozen dataclasses, `from_*` classmethods, loud failure on bad input.
- Cross-cutting — `from __future__ import annotations` everywhere; config via `$MOLHUB_HOME`, `$MOLHUB_REGISTRY`, `$MOLHUB_SOURCE_BASE`, `$FIGSHARE_TOKEN`, `$HF_TOKEN` (`$MOLHUB_CACHE_DIR` deprecated); torch enters only through `MolnexBlockWriter`'s lazy `molix` import.

### Layer roles

Layers: **L1 transport** (locator → bytes) · **L2 resolution** (coordinate → manifest → locators) · **L3 semantic** (bytes → `Frame` / `Trajectory`) · **conveyor** (block bookkeeping, residency, prepare — beside L3, above L1/L2) · **L4 loader façade** (name + split → dataset object).

- `coordinate.py`, `manifest.py`, `registry.py` — **L2**, pure. `molhub.py` — **L2 facade over L1**; the one place a coordinate becomes a cache key. `cli.py` — **above L4**; presentation only.
- `sources/*` — **L1**; guarded by `tests/test_sources/test_layering.py` (no imports of coordinate / manifest / dataset).
- `dataset/{protocol,hub,definition,neighbor,transforms}.py` — **L3 contracts**; no network, no locators. `dataset/cache.py` — L1/L2 for un-coordinated inputs. The dataset classes — **L3 with an L2 handle** (`COORDINATE` + `ArtifactHub` seam; `Molhub` constructed only when `hub is None`).
- `conveyor/{block,ledger,splits,coverage,tier,backpressure,errors}.py` — bookkeeping, stdlib + `sources.digest` only. `conveyor/{roster,transfer}.py` — conveyor ↔ L1/L2. `conveyor/{encoder,prepare}.py` — CPU stage; numpy, `molix` only inside `MolnexBlockWriter`.
- `loader/*` — **L4**; reads down into `dataset/`, `conveyor/`, `registry`/`manifest`/`coordinate`, `Molhub`, `sources.BlobStore`.
- `uploader/*` — outside the read path; deprecated write-side shims.

Layering edges, as the code stands:

- **loader → {dataset, conveyor, registry/manifest/coordinate, molhub, sources.blobs}, one-way.** No module under `dataset/` or `conveyor/` imports `molhub.loader` (three docstring cross-references only). Enforced by `tests/test_loader/test_layering.py` (AST walk).
- **Free-function sanction scoped to `loader/`**: `load_dataset` + `load_dataset_builder` in `loader/__init__.py`; `prepare` defined in `loader/materialize.py`, re-exported from `loader/__init__.py` and `molhub/__init__.py`. Same test asserts no other loader module declares a public free function.
- Two public free functions outside the sanction, both deliberate: `molhub.dataset.definition.dataset` (class decorator) and `molhub.conveyor.default_ledger_path` (shared path decision).
- `_SplitTable` (private to `conveyor.splits`) imported by private name from `loader/{builder,mapstyle,materialize}.py` — deliberate in-distribution reach-through (D9), not exported.
- L1 isolation guarded by `tests/test_sources/test_layering.py`; conveyor has its own `tests/test_conveyor/test_layering.py`.

## Inventory delta (2026-08-15, 98e1260 → ae738c8 — usability-fix waves A–F)

The base inventory above predates the usability-fix waves. Corrections, verified per file:line by the delta inventory:

### Module list

- **NEW subpackage `src/molhub/scripts/`** — shipped runnable derivations ("a derivation the product requires is part of the product"; one `main(argv=None, ...) -> int` per module, entry points not public API):
  - `build_class1_splits.py` — `ThemolIndexes` + `MoleculeSplits` + `main`; writes `dataset:molcrafts/class1-universal-splits@1` under `$MOLHUB_HOME/derived/`; `--fetch` gates the multi-GB index download (without it: nothing fetched, nothing written, exit 1). Run as `python -m molhub.scripts.build_class1_splits`.
  - `convert_espaloma_phalkethoh_mm.py` — `PhalkethohConversion` + `main`; offline DGL→`splits.json`/`mols/` conversion; `dgl` imported lazily so `--help` answers without it.
  - Repo-root `scripts/build_class1_splits.py` / `scripts/convert_espaloma_phalkethoh_mm.py` are delegating shims. Wheel membership enforced by `scripts/check_package_contents.py`.
- **NEW `src/molhub/loader/errors.py`** — `SplitTableUnavailable` (derivation absent; names the self-serve command) and `UnknownSplit(KeyError)` (renders its own sentence). Deliberately not a `SplitProvenanceMismatch` subclass.
- `loader/info.py` — gained `ByteSize` (frozen, 1024-based rendering) and `DatasetInfo.__str__` (content-first block through it).
- `loader/mapstyle.py` — gained `DownloadNotice` (one stderr notice per published-file set, silent on cache hits/repeats); `ShardIndex(..., notice=)`; `SplitDataset.__repr__`; Index/TypeErrors name coordinate/split/bound.
- `loader/builder.py` — hierarchy is now `TableBackedSplits` / `DeclaredSplits` → `UnconvertedPayload` (`ZincTypingSplits`, `PhalkethohSplits` — refuse before any fetch, naming the conversion) / `ThreeBPASplits` / `WholeContentSplits` → `QM9WholeView`, `PolymerTgWholeView` (no published split ⇒ whole content served as `train`, HF idiom). `DECLARATIONS` = 8 entries; `water-les` delisted (`WaterLESSplits` deleted — coordinate unresolvable). `_CLASS_API_ESCAPES` (data table, not a branch) holds `revmd17` (+`molecule=`) and the two THEMol relax artifacts (+`.load(role=`), whose refusals hand over the open class API; reader-less artifacts point at `molhub fetch`.
- `dataset/themol.py` — `THEMolMBIS` emits the shell-major `mbis_shells` block (`atom`/`population`/`inverse_width`, one row per MBIS Slater shell, S ≠ N; four loud refusals) instead of per-atom `mbis_parameter_<slot>` columns; declares `blocks=("mbis_shells",)`. `universal_class_i.py` moves `mbis_shells` to the `qm=` meaning axis with per-column `<block>.<column>` units.
- `dataset/{threebpa,phalkethoh_mm}.py` — gained `@dataset(...)` declarations (so `.manifest` exists) with `units` (`eV`/`eV/angstrom`; `kcal/mol`/`kcal/mol/angstrom`); `water_les.py`'s existing declaration gained the same eV units. `qm9/csv_dataset/revmd17/zinc_typing` stay undecorated (builder falls back to an empty manifest; zinc's empty `units` is deliberate and pinned).
- `cli.py` — `info` gained `--home`; byte totals render through `ByteSize`; the pre-download stderr notice moved INTO the library (`DownloadNotice` via `DatasetBuilder.info`), so the CLI no longer owns one.
- Tests — NEW `tests/test_scripts/` (build_class1_splits, convert_espaloma_phalkethoh_mm, check_package_contents). `loader/errors.py` has no mirrored `test_errors.py` (8 loader modules vs 6 mirrors).

### Public surface (highlights)

- `molhub.__all__` grew: `Feature`, `SplitInfo`, `PreparedBlocks`, `AllLocatorsFailed`, `AmbiguousRevision`, `SplitProvenanceMismatch`, `SplitTableUnavailable`, `UnknownRecordKey`, `UnknownSplit`, `UnroutableUnitError`, `UnsupportedRecordError` — every exception a public docstring names is catchable from `import molhub`. `ByteSize` is exported from `molhub.loader` but deliberately NOT from the root.
- `load_dataset` is `@overload`-narrowed on `streaming: Literal[True|False]` → `StreamingSplitDataset | Dataset`; omitting `split=` raises a molhub-authored `TypeError` naming `load_dataset_builder(name).info.splits`. Signatures are user-first, injected seams last; `DatasetBuilder` gained `home=` and `__repr__`.
- `materialize`: `BlockExport.refuse_unroutable(coordinate)` / `resolve_writer(factory)` promoted public (called from builder for hoisted cheap refusals); the mbis refusal raises `from None` (single error, no conveyor chain); `$MOLNEX_SRC` honored (sys.path insert before the molix probe).
- `streaming`: both walk types have real reprs; a mid-stream CRASH preserves the cached shard (close+release only) while `GeneratorExit`/`take` keeps consumed→unlink→remote; digest-less manifests surface as a reader-facing `ValueError` advising `streaming=False`.

### Layer roles

- New tier above L4: **entry points** — `cli.py` and `scripts/*` (presentation + runnable derivations). `scripts/*` read down into loader/conveyor/dataset.hub/molhub/registry/sources; nothing under `src/molhub/` imports them (every cross-reference is a string literal naming a command). Property true today but **unenforced** — no layering test covers `molhub.scripts` (named follow-up).
- The free-function sanction (3 names in loader) holds; `molhub.scripts.*.main` are script entry points outside it by design.
- `loader/__init__.py` also imports `molhub.sources.errors` (re-export of `AllLocatorsFailed`) — add to the read-down edge list.
- Byte rendering is one shared decision (`ByteSize` — CLI, `DatasetInfo.__str__`, `DownloadNotice`), same promotion pattern as `default_ledger_path`/`DEFAULT_BUDGET_BYTES`. Env vars gained `$MOLNEX_SRC`.
- One recorded divergence: `build_class1_splits.py` re-spells `BlobStore`'s `$MOLHUB_HOME → ~/.cache/molhub` fallback as an argparse default instead of delegating.
